answers.core_task: Understand what to look at today.
answers.never_do_or_show: Never present research as financial advice. Never use unexplained finance jargon — every term gets a plain-English definition. Never touch the live app — design work in replicas only.
answers.non_technical_user: An invited reader with no finance background, checking on a phone. (Ankit himself is a day trader; the reader is not.)
answers.what_are_we_building: Revamp TradeDesk, a stock-research app, so a person with no finance background understands 'what should I look at today' in 10 seconds.

internal.device_already_used: Phone first; tablet and desktop as well. Ankit checks on his own phone and tablet.
internal.replaces: Yahoo Finance watchlists and news, broker apps, Seeking Alpha articles, spreadsheets, Reddit and X finfluencers.

notes: Live app: https://apatel85.github.io/Dashboards/TradeDesk/ (redirects to /dist/). Research and education only, never financial advice.
Mock B (Command center, editorial-ledger layout) already chosen by Ankit on Nov 12, 2026 as the Daily Brief design, with detail tabs linked from it and everything collapsed by default.
